'''Yanus Melikan''', nicknamed '''Mel''', was the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] who served as cargo master for [[Javul Charn]]'s private [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]], the ''[[Nova's Heart]]''. Melikan was secretly a [[Commander/Legends|commander]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[Corellian Guard]].
